jobs.description:
About SpotOn

We’re not just building restaurant tech, we’re giving independent restaurants the tools to compete and win. From our award-winning point-of-sale to AI-powered profit tools, everything we do helps operators boost profit, work smarter, and keep their best people. And every solution is backed by real humans who actually give a sh*t about helping restaurants succeed.

Named the #1 Restaurant POS by G2 (Summer 2026), based on ratings from real users
Rated the top-rated point-of-sale (POS) for restaurants, bars, retail, and small businesses by Capterra users
Awarded Great Places to Work and Built In’s Best Workplaces for multiple years running

We move fast, care hard, and fight for independent restaurant operators to do what they love, and love doing it. If you’re looking to make an impact with heart and hustle, SpotOn is the place for you.

Senior Data Analyst,

This is a hybrid position, 3-4x
/week in our San Francisco office.

Why this role exists

Behind every renewal, cancellation, software adoption, and support conversation is an opportunity to better understand what helps our merchants succeed. This role exists to turn those signals into action.

You'll help SpotOn understand the moments that matter throughout a merchant's journey, from their first interaction with our platform to go-live, and long-term success. You'll uncover what helps merchants thrive, where we can improve, and how we can build better experiences at every stage. Your work will influence decisions across Customer Experience, Sales, Finance, Product, and Engineering.

The impact you'll have

Retention is one of the highest-leverage opportunities at SpotOn. Every improvement means more merchants growing their business with us, stronger recurring revenue, and better products built from real customer insights.

As the owner of merchant retention and SaaS analytics, you'll help shape how we measure success, prioritize investments, and make decisions across the company. It's an opportunity to influence strategy through data.

Our team

You'll join a Finance & Data Analytics team where ownership is part of how we work. We build systems that make trusted insights available to everyone, helping teams spend less time finding answers and more time helping merchants succeed.

What You’ll Accomplish

You'll own the analytics that power SpotOn's merchant retention and SaaS business.

You'll

Identify the drivers behind merchant retention, churn, and software adoption.
Build trusted metrics, dashboards, and analyses used by executives and cross-functional leaders.
Partner with Product, Customer Success, Finance, Sales, and Engineering to turn insights into action.
Create scalable reporting, data models, and AI-powered workflows that reduce manual work and improve decision making.
Measure the impact of retention initiatives so we invest in what works.

Some weeks you'll spend hours in SQL untangling a complex problem. Other weeks you'll present recommendations to executives, automate recurring analyses, or build tools that eliminate repetitive work.

Success in this role is measured by the decisions you help the business make, and ultimately, by merchants who stay, grow, and succeed with SpotOn. If you see a problem worth solving, you have the ownership to solve it and the support to make it happen.

You should apply if you…

Notice when a merchant, a process, or a metric doesn't add up and treat that as an opportunity.
Aren't satisfied stopping at "churn is up" - you need to know why, down to the root cause, even when the answer is uncomfortable.
Like going deep enough to become the person people ask about a problem, but know when "good enough" beats another week of polish.
Aren't afraid to pick up a new tool, language, or AI assistant mid-project if it gets you to the answer faster.
Enjoy tinkering with AI coding tools like Claude Code/Codex as a way to move faster on real analysis.
Want your work to outlive the request it came from - you'd rather build the dashboard or create a scalable process after answering the same questions too many times
Believe in data-driven decisions, but have the judgment to know when the data isn't there yet and a decision still has to be made.
Have a track record of working well across Finance, Sales and Customer Success because the best answer to a retention question rarely lives in one team.

What We're Looking For

5+ years of experience in Analytics, Business Intelligence, or a related analytical role, ideally with experience in the Software industry.
Advanced SQL skills with experience working in cloud data warehouses (Snowflake preferred).
Experience with customer retention analyses
Experience building dashboards and reporting in Power BI or similar BI tools.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate complex business questions.
Experience translating data into clear business recommendations.
Comfortable working independently in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.
Experience with Python, dbt, AI coding assistants, or workflow automation tools is a plus.
Excellent communication skills and a collaborative mindset.
Bonus Point: Experience with Netsuite (or comparable ERP), SaaS metrics, subscription businesses

Please note the salary range listed is just one component of a competitive compensation package, which includes a company stock plan
Offers will be reflective of the candidate’s location and experience.

Benefits

At SpotOn, we put people above everything else. We’re known for our innovative software and technology solutions, but we stand out because of the hard-working humans behind the tech. We can’t take care of our clients without taking care of our employees first, and that’s why we invest in you with a competitive benefits package which includes:

APPLY HERE:

Not every environmental science job changes how California manages its forests. This one does.

The California Board of Forestry and Fire Protection is looking for a Senior Environmental Scientist (LT)
to join our team.

If you're the kind of scientist who wants to do more than write reports—if you want your work to influence policy, shape regulations, tackle emerging environmental challenges, and help guide the future of California's forests and fire resilience—we'd encourage you to take a serious look.

This isn't a position where your work disappears into a filing cabinet.

You'll work alongside foresters, biologists, policymakers, fire professionals, and legal experts on some of California's most complex and high-profile natural resource issues. From forest resilience and vegetation management to environmental review and statewide policy development, you'll have a seat at the table where important decisions are made.

Yes, it's a limited-term position
but it's also an opportunity to build relationships, gain invaluable experience in state government, and make a meaningful impact while working with a small, highly motivated team that values new ideas and fresh perspectives.

If you've been looking for a way to break into state service—or you're ready for your next challenge—this might be it.

Come help shape the future of California's forests.

Company Description
The California Board of Forestry & Fire Protection is a state agency that develops and implements policies related to forest management, wildfire prevention, and natural resource protection across California. The Board works closely with other state and local agencies, scientific experts, and community stakeholders to promote sustainable forestry practices and reduce wildfire risk. Its mission includes balancing environmental conservation with responsible land use and public safety. Team members contribute to evidence-based policy decisions that shape how California’s forests and wildlands are managed for current and future generations.

Role Description
The Senior Environmental Scientist will provide advanced scientific and technical expertise to support the Board’s forestry and wildfire-related programs in California, United States. This temporary, on-site role involves conducting environmental analyses, reviewing project proposals, and preparing technical reports and documentation to inform regulatory and policy decisions. The position includes evaluating potential impacts of forestry practices and fire management activities, coordinating environmental review processes, and ensuring compliance with relevant state and federal laws and regulations. The Senior Environmental Scientist will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, engage with stakeholders, and present findings and recommendations in meetings and public forums. The role also entails mentoring junior staff, contributing to the development of guidance documents, and supporting continuous improvement of environmental and resource management practices.

Qualifications

Demonstrated expertise in environmental science, forestry, ecology, or a closely related field, with the ability to apply scientific principles to forest and wildfire management issues.
Strong skills in environmental impact assessment, regulatory compliance review (e.g., CEQA/NEPA), and preparation of technical reports and scientific documentation.
Experience in data collection and analysis, including use of field methods, GIS or spatial analysis tools, and interpretation of environmental and resource-related datasets.
Effective communication skills for presenting complex scientific information in clear written and verbal form to technical and non-technical audiences, including stakeholders and decision-makers.
Proven ability to work collaboratively in multidisciplinary teams, manage multiple projects and deadlines, and exercise sound professional judgment in a policy and regulatory environment.
Relevant advanced education such as a bachelor’s or master’s degree in environmental science, forestry, natural resources, ecology, or a related discipline.
Experience with California-specific environmental regulations, forest practices, and wildfire prevention or response programs is highly beneficial.

Description

Ledcor Technical Services has been building and servicing communication networks for customers across North America since 1979. Utilizing our broad expertise and experience, we customize solutions to best meet our client's needs. We act as a key partner for our clients by delivering exceptional quality, reliability, and safety in all that we do.

Join our team as a proactive and detail-driven Project Coordinator, where you’ll play a key role in managing telecom operations and project performance. This hybrid role blends coordination of field operations with cost tracking and performance analysis, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards. You will collaborate with project managers, engineers, and field teams while also interfacing with clients and stakeholders.

Apply today to become a part of the Ledcor Technical Services team and take the next step in your career!

Essential Responsibilities:

Coordinate and track all phases of telecom maintenance and construction projects, including scheduling, materials, access, and closure
Maintain and update project logs, CRM systems, and Excel trackers to reflect real-time project status
Conduct weekly update calls and meetings with internal teams and clients
Generate and submit daily work-in-progress (WIP) reports and training summaries
Support project cost tracking, including labor, materials, subcontractors, and equipment
Assist in preparing cost reports, forecasts, and earned value metrics (CPI, SPI, EAC)
Utilize tools like Excel and Power BI to generate performance and status reports
Support change management processes and ensure accurate billing and documentation
Collaborate with field managers to ensure job readiness and timely project completion
Participate in stakeholder meetings and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives

Qualifications:

One to Three years of experience in construction project coordination or construction project controls (telecommunications experience is preferred)
Familiarity with U.S. telecommunications providers and their operational protocols
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, Lookups, IF Statements, etc.); Power BI and SAP experience is a plus
Understanding of project performance metrics such as CPI, SPI, and EAC
Experience with Work Breakdown Structures (WBS) and Cost Breakdown Structures (CBS) is an asset
Excellent communication and time management skills
Ability to work independently and adapt to changing priorities
Willingness to travel up to 15% to project sites or offices

Work Conditions:

This position offers the flexibility to work remotely from a home office with occasional travel to various Ledcor offices and project sites in the state of Kentucky

Additional Information

Ledcor Technical Services (LTS) designs, builds, and maintains wireline or wireless networks that span North America and beyond. We are a proven leader and innovator in telecommunications network construction, maintenance, and service installation and repair.
